name: smolvm v1.34.4
body:
## What's Changed
* docs: say that virtiofs DAX is off on arm64 hosts and SMOLVM_MOUNT_DAX does nothing there by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2087
* Add smolvm docker: one command starts a Docker engine in a managed machine and points docker at it by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2089
* Share the home directory with the smolvm docker machine at the same path by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2090
* Resolve host.docker.internal to the host from smolvm docker containers by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2091
* Fix a port race in the leader-exit test by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2096
* Remove smolvm docker by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2095
* Hand supplied credential values to a running embedded machine at once by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2097
* Pin libkrunfw with UDP kept inside a TSI guest, and test it by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2099
* Publish ports below 1024 on macOS, add IPv6 loopback to live-forwarded ports, and lift the 64-mapping cap by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2092
* Return idle guest memory to the host within two minutes and cap new machines at half the host's RAM by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2094
* Install a root-owned agent-rootfs when root runs install.sh by @rdslw in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2082
* Announce a changed file to the guest once per change by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2102
* Answer guest DNS from a host cache that coalesces bursts and resends lost queries by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2098
* Keep every disk chain under the branch depth limit: fold restored checkpoint layers and frozen-source chains by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2103
* Exec sessions: commands the node owns, resumable after a dropped connection by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2101
* Let a guest hold tens of thousands of connections on virtio-net and free their host sockets promptly by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2104
* Scope the usage journal to the test's own thread by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2106
* Pin libkrun 526be460 and libkrunfw f290c62b, rebuilt for every platform by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2109
* Build the agent rootfs as non-root on hosts with user namespaces again by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2107
* Answer a start missing the mediated interceptor with 400, not 500 by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2108
* Run tests that need a released file lock free at once in their own process by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2110
* Pin libkrun 9df62257 and libkrunfw 7f4d4950, rebuilt for every platform by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2113
* Stop resetting virtio-net connections a server closes first by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2118
* Upgrade rusqlite to 0.41 for the patched bundled SQLite (RUSTSEC-2026-0459) by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2128
* Keep a host memory reserve VMs cannot take and charge branch children for growth by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2127
* Ask before stopping a machine on delete, so a refused or declined delete leaves it running by @connorburgess in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2131
* Prepare SmolVM v1.34.1 for release by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2135
* Bring a soft open-file limit above kern.maxfilesperproc down to the cap on macOS, so the limit raise_nofile_limit reports is the one in force by @connorburgess in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2132
* Leave no data directory behind when exec, status or stop name a machine that does not exist by @connorburgess in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2129
* Warn when --block-private keeps a named host unreachable by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2146
* Register Rosetta itself as the x86_64 interpreter when the host answers its start-up ioctl by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2148
* Make a mounted host directory belong to the workload user so a non-root workload can write to it by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2149
* Record the image platform on the machine so a Rosetta machine can be created from an amd64 image by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2147
* Bump libkrun so a Rosetta machine runs amd64 programs directly and a macOS machine stops promptly by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2150
* Keep a cache disk's chain on its shared base when compaction shortens it by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2145
* Satisfy Rust 1.100's needless_bool lint in connect_in_progress on Windows by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2154
* Bound branch admission and reported capacity by the VM slice's memory limit, not just host free memory by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2152
* Stop throttling the VM slice and reclaim it from the pressure guard instead by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2153
* Release a paused branch child's VM lock so the memory pressure guard can resume it by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2157
* Keep a restored machine's local image on its storage disk instead of mounting the capturing host's archive by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2163
* Update quinn-udp to 0.5.16 for RUSTSEC-2026-0538 by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2165
* Count every symlink with one mode in the agent rootfs digest so a Mac checkpoint restores on Linux by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2162
* Carry guest traffic in 64 KB frames over the gateway link so downloads use a quarter of the CPU by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2168
* Pin libkrun 518949b4 and libkrunfw 0fae3853, rebuilt for every platform by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2169

## New Contributors
* @rdslw made their first contribution in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2082
* @connorburgess made their first contribution in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2131

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/compare/v1.34.0...v1.34.4
